description: Performs deterministic reconciliation between commercial invoice items and packing list / waybill shipping manifests. Compares line-item quantities, gross/net weights, declared customs values, and flags variances exceeding legal tolerances.

invoiceItems.description: List of items as stated on the commercial invoice.

shippingItems.description: List of items as recorded on the transport waybill or physical packing list.

name: datacastle_reconcile_freight_discrepancy
